notes:
I couldn't do the research for Hosea 1 this time, so I have no notes to give you.

My first attempt tried to open seven pages at once: Enduring Word, Precept Austin, three Bible Hub commentary pages (vv. 2, 4 and 10), Got Questions' article on Hosea and Gomer, and the NET Bible notes. That went over the tool's usage limit. A second try with just the Enduring Word page was refused because I had no tool calls left for this turn. As a result, I didn't read a single page.

Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say and never to fill gaps from my own knowledge. So I haven't written any notes from memory, because they would have no real URLs behind them.

**Next step:** if you ask again in a new message, I'll open the pages one or two at a time so I don't hit the limit. I'll start with the main verse-by-verse sources:
- enduringword.com/bible-commentary/hosea-1/
- Bible Hub's Hosea 1 pages (Gill, Ellicott, Pulpit)
- preceptaustin.org

Then I'll look for:
- **Where Protestant traditions differ:** mainly v. 2 (was Gomer already a prostitute when Hosea married her, or did she become unfaithful later?) and vv. 10–11 (how this relates to Romans 9:25–26 and 1 Peter 2:10, and what it means for Israel and the church).
- **Other views:** NET Bible notes, Bible Odyssey, and Catholic and Orthodox sources, only where they actually say something.

You'll then get notes verse by verse ("v. 4: ..."), with a URL after each point.
